name: Profile Image
description: Generated from the site's profile image: its strongest color becomes the accent over soft warm neutrals.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: Generated by @portfolio/appearance/generators profile-image, version 1: image-palette@1, a first-party quantizer and scorer, picks the image's two best colors over the reviewed prototype's canvas and text, and anchor-v2 solves the rest.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the high-contrast sets the generator solves with high-contrast-v2, and print renders the light set.
caveats: Renders from the sets a draft save generates from the site's appearanceInputs entry and stores with the revision. Until a site has them, warm-parchment renders in its place.
Image-derived: it stays out of every build until the owner accepts its reference output, and a generated set waits for the owner too.
